text:
Attorney Smith (attorney): Good morning. Can you please state your name for the record?
Jane Doe (witness): My name is Jane Doe.
Attorney Smith (attorney): Ms. Doe, were you the CEO of Acme Corporation from 2010 until 2015?
Jane Doe (witness): I was never the CEO of that company.
Attorney Smith (attorney): So you're saying you were never the CEO of Acme Corporation?
Jane Doe (witness): That's correct. I was never the CEO.
Attorney Smith (attorney): Can you tell me about your role at Acme Corporation during that time period?
Jane Doe (witness): I was the Chief Operating Officer from 2012 to 2016.
Attorney Smith (attorney): And when did you first join Acme Corporation?
Jane Doe (witness): I joined the company in 2010 as a senior executive.
Attorney Smith (attorney): Thank you. That's all for now.
